title: Study finds sustainable farming program helps refugees, immigrants boost health while launching agribusinesses
summary_en: New Roots is a Kansas City-area program that works with resettled refugees, immigrants and English language learners to learn sustainable practices to start agribusinesses. Research from the University of Kansas found the program boosts the mental and physical health of participants while they connect with community, benefiting both the farmers and the areas they serve.
title_cn: Study finds sustainable farming program helps refugees, immigrants boost health while launching agribusinesses

title: KU institute to publish 60th edition of Kansas Statistical Abstract
summary_en: The 2025 Kansas Statistical Abstract will be available online Sept. 1. This data compendium is published annually by the Institute for Policy & Social Research at the University of Kansas and includes information on a wide range of topics about Kansas.
title_cn: KU institute to publish 60th edition of Kansas Statistical Abstract

title: KU welcomes more than 70 new faculty members across Lawrence and Edwards campuses
summary_en: The Office of Faculty Affairs welcomed new full- and part-time faculty to the University of Kansas during orientation, which took place Aug. 17, 18 and 19. This year’s new faculty cohort represents 39 units across the KU Lawrence and Edwards campuses.
title_cn: KU welcomes more than 70 new faculty members across Lawrence and Edwards campuses
